scope: Catalog lookup outage handling in configured post-download autotag workflow; pre-download audio verification remains separate
behavior: MusicBrainz recording-search and Discogs lookup errors no longer prevent subsequent configured recognition fallbacks.
If no candidate or recognition succeeds, the first catalog error is retained instead of misreporting a clean no-match.
Failed optional release context marks otherwise valid candidates review-only; it cannot trigger automatic tag application.
Fingerprint settings and external-service consent requirements are unchanged.
limitations: Service results were simulated in the new regression; no live audio/fingerprint request made.
This does not add pre-download sample verification or prove the historical Por ella failure cause.
Recognizer-service errors themselves keep their existing behavior.
